author: Pixar YouTube
text:
Cars: Route 66 Road Trip | The People | Episode 3
Join us as we celebrate the Cars 20th anniversary and 100 years of Route 66  while we recreate the original Cars research trip the Pixar team took 25 years ago. @jofranco, travel content creator, joins up with Jonas Rivera, Production Manager on Cars to visit the iconic Teepee Curios. And then just 100 yards away, met up with Tony Shalhoub, voice of Luigi, at Blue Swallow Motel to talk character legacy.

Disney & Pixar’s Cars is racing back into theaters September 4. And watch the Cars Collection now streaming on Disney+.
